item.title: Flask Deployment: Werkzeug Dev Server vs. Production WSGI Servers
item.description:
“Flask Deployment: Werkzeug Dev Server vs. Production WSGI Servers”

When building web applications with Flask, the server you use for running your application significantly impacts its performance, stability, and security. Flask’s built-in server, Werkzeug’s development WSGI server, is fantastic for development but is not suitable for production environments. This post delves into why and what alternatives are recommended.

Why is Flask’s Development Server Not for Production?
